text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — elevated 5xx rate observed from inference cluster us-east-1 (model-serving runtime). Error spike started ~15:02 UTC, now ~7.8% 5xx across /v1/generate. Paging @mira-oncall and @sam-runtime. Runbook: investigate model-runner crashes/ooms. https://runbook.internal/incidents/infer-5xx

mira-oncall: I'm taking the pager. Spawning log collection and enabling verbose runtime traces. Any immediate customer impact reports?

sam-runtime: Seeing repeated segfaults and OOMs in model-runner on nodes gpu-12,gpu-27. Kernel logs show repeated "Killed process" + coredumps. Small sample from /var/log/model-runner.log:
```
2026-03-17T15:02:13Z model-runner[pid=2345]: kvcache: growth to 42GB, eviction lagged
2026-03-17T15:02:14Z model-runner[pid=2345]: quant-attention: alloc failed, oom
2026-03-17T15:02:14Z kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 2345 (model-runner)
```

lee-ml-ops: We rolled a quantized attention patch last night to reduce cost — that landed on the staging branch and then promoted. Possible regression in kernel memory footprint.

alicia-support: I'm drafting a short status update: "We are investigating increased error rates for generation requests in us-east-1. Mitigation in progress." Will post to status page once we have mitigation action.

dan-cs: Flagging three large customers on dedicated capacity in us-east-1 — they're seeing 502s. Sending heads-up emails now.

mira-oncall: Mitigation plan per runbook: 1) divert traffic for affected model to fallback-small model 2) cordon nodes gpu-12/gpu-27 3) restart model-runner on affected hosts and collect cores 4) scale up healthy replica pool. Starting step 1 now: updating traffic router to route 30% to fallback.

sam-runtime: Router change applied. 30% diverted to fallback-small. Immediately seeing 5xx drop from 7.8% -> 3.1%. Initiating cordon and restart on gpu-12. Collecting core and uploading to s3://redwood-debug/3666001234/cores/

lee-ml-ops: Quick hotpatch to limit kv cache per-process to 12GB for model-runner is ready. If we can apply it on the remaining nodes it should prevent further growth while we investigate root cause. Do we want to push now?

mira-oncall: Push hotpatch to non-cordoned nodes only. Avoid touching nodes mid-restart. Apply to gpu-27 after restart completes.

sam-runtime: Restarted model-runner on gpu-12 with --max-cache=12g. Core from previous crash uploaded. Attaching short gdb backtrace:
```
#0 0x00007f9a... in attention_kernel
#1 0x00007f9a... in quant_attention_dispatch
#2 0x0000555f... in model_runner::serve_request
```

alicia-support: Status update posted: "We are mitigating an increased error rate impacting generation requests in us-east-1. Traffic is being routed to fallback models and we are restarting affected hosts. We'll post another update in 30 minutes." :hourglass_flowing_sand:

dan-cs: Customers notified. One asks for ETA — told them we're targeting containment within 30 minutes and a fuller postmortem tomorrow.

lee-ml-ops: Hotpatch applied to remaining replicas in us-east-1 (excluding cordoned). Monitoring memory growth now. Hypothesis: quant-attention regression combined with unbounded kv cache under certain long-seq workloads.

mira-oncall: After hotpatch + diversion errors are down to 1.1% over last 5m. Keeping nodes cordoned until we confirm stable. Continuing to collect traces and cores for root cause. Will escalate to SEC/Legal if we see customer data exposure indicators (none so far).

incident-bot: Incident updated — mitigation in progress. Pager will remain until error rate < 0.5% and no crashes for 30m. Runbook link: https://runbook.internal/infra/infer-runtime-oom
